name: znetwork_dplay_select_service_provider_and_init_connection
description: zNetworkDPlay::SelectServiceProviderAndInitConnection releases the current DirectPlay object, creates a new DirectPlay4 object for providers with connection data, updates modem/TCP provider flags, and initializes the provider connection.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The smoke patches the accepted direct callees to isolate provider-selection control flow from COM and DirectPlay runtime state.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48a180 validates the fastcall provider-info ABI, close/release of g_zNetwork_pDirectPlay4 followed by clearing the global, the connectionData-null return path, CreateInterfaceAndCoInitialize(&g_zNetwork_pDirectPlay4), ReportError line 0x8f on create failure, zero return when creation succeeds but the DirectPlay pointer is null, strstr checks for Modem and TCP/IP in displayName, mirroring the TCP/IP flag into g_zNetwork_TcpIpAsyncSendEnabled, and returning InitializeConnectionFromProviderInfo(providerInfo).

The native smoke verifies no-connection-data, create failure, null created interface, TCP/IP modem, and nonmatching provider cases, including old DirectPlay close argument, global clearing, out-pointer passed to create, modem/TCP/async flags, initializer forwarding, and create-error report line.
